objective: Prepare a package release-readiness candidate with source/package/docs validation and release-fix review only. This packaged graph must never version-bump, commit, tag, push, publish, or create releases.

steps.task: Map current version, dirty state, changelog/package/docs/examples/tests, README Public npm release handoff obligations, and npm registry version state. Use bash only for these bounded read-only probes: git status -sb, git diff --check, npm view pi-multiagent version versions dist-tags time --json, npm pack --dry-run --json. Do not version-bump, commit, tag, push, publish, or create releases.

Inspect package contents and public docs for stale or missing release-critical surfaces using upstream evidence and read/discovery tools. Do not version-bump, commit, tag, push, publish, or create releases. Return findings first with exact paths.

steps.mutationScope: REPLACE before start. Allowed files/globs: <exact release-readiness paths>. Allowed mutation class: <specific release-readiness fix type>. Explicit exclusions: version bump, commit, tag, push, publish, release creation, and <additional paths/actions not allowed>. Validation commands authorized: <exact commands or none>. Stop if broader than current parent authorization.
steps.task: Apply only that authorized release-readiness scope across docs, metadata, examples, and tests. If mutationScope is still a placeholder, missing, or broader than the parent authorization, return blocker evidence without editing. Do not version-bump, commit, tag, push, publish, or create releases. Return changed paths and validation.

Run only release-candidate commands explicitly copied here by the parent: REPLACE_WITH_EXACT_RELEASE_COMMANDS. Canonical local release commands are pnpm run gate; pnpm run check:release; npm pack --dry-run --json; npm publish --dry-run --json; git diff --check. Run PI_MULTIAGENT_REAL_SMOKE=1 PI_MULTIAGENT_REAL_SMOKE_TIMEOUT_MS=180000 pnpm run smoke:pi only if explicit real-runtime smoke approval is copied here. If this placeholder remains, no commands are present, or scope is only implied by upstream evidence, return needs-command-scope without running commands. Do not version-bump, commit, tag, push, publish, or create releases. Return pass/fail/deferred with exact commands.

Preserve audit findings, validation commands, package identity, block/ship recommendation, and README Public npm release handoff steps as not-executed human-owned next actions after all lanes terminalize, including failed or blocked lane evidence. Do not invent validation or claim publication, and do not version-bump, commit, tag, push, publish, or create releases.
